name: L. CORDERO
subtitle: Auditable AI for courts and the people they serve.

primary.label: PRIMARY MISSION
primary.name: Verity Lex
primary.hook: Everyone is selling AI to government. Who has checked whether government is ready to buy?
primary.body: Scores a California superior court's AI readiness from its own public record, against Rule of Court 10.430, Gov. Code 68150, and Rule of Court 10.500. An agentic scan gathers evidence. A deterministic rule engine assigns the score. The AI reads the record. It never assigns the score.
primary.stack: Next.js · TypeScript · GPT-5.6 · Codex · Tavily · Docker · Vercel

second.label: SECOND IN COMMAND
second.name: Agentis Lux
second.hook: Your website has a second audience now: AI agents.
second.body: Shows what retrieval agents experience when they read your site. Paste a URL or an OpenAPI spec, get one report across six categories for frontend and API. Findings, not fixes. Full CI, smoke-tested deploys, SSRF hardening on every redirect hop.
second.stack: Next.js · TypeScript · AWS Lambda · CDK · Bedrock · DynamoDB
second.footer: H0: Hack the Zero Stack, June 2026 · agentislux.io

drydock.label: IN DRYDOCK
drydock.name: Dead Keys
drydock.hook: A typing game, back from the dead.
drydock.body: In 2000, almost half of US high school grads took a typing class. By 2019 it was 2.5%. Dead Keys rebuilds the 1980s typing games I grew up on as a trainer that notices which keys you miss and drills them. It picks up where Office Keys left off.

fleet.name: Observator Clew
fleet.line: Creating is becoming nearly free. Maintaining never did. Watches my GitHub estate and learns when not to bother me. Mk II of Daybreak.

fleet.name: Two Sisters Tinctures
fleet.line: My little sister is my skincare product whisperer. So I built her a shelf that sorts morning and evening order and flags what shouldn't layer.

fleet.name: Clew Directive
fleet.line: Four questions. A personalized path from verified free resources. A PDF you keep forever. No signup, no data stored.

fleet.name: Janus Clew
fleet.line: You shipped three projects in three months. You're better, but can you prove it? Janus measures it. Evidence, not vibes.

fleet.name: Memoria Clew
fleet.line: Bookmarks don't remember why you saved something. Memoria does, and resurfaces it when it matters again.

fleet.name: Metis Clew
fleet.line: What the code does, how it works, and why it was built that way. Validated with career switchers.

away.name: Themis Lex
away.line: Plain-English AI readiness check for California court staff, as a PDF you can hand your supervisor.

away.name: Porch Light
away.line: Watches city meeting agendas for one resident. English and Spanish, a receipt on every claim. Drafts a comment only a human can send.
